title: The rate-distortion region for distributed lossy source coding
formal: Characterize the achievable rate pairs for separate encoding of two correlated discrete memoryless sources with a joint decoder, subject to given per-source expected distortion constraints.
context:
The lossless Slepian–Wolf theorem and the one-sided side-information setting do not settle this general lossy problem.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: The basic unresolved limit of compressing correlated information without coordination between encoders.
